note: The sixteen-slot character sheet. This is the structured parameter table the prompt assembler fills in. Order matters: slots are emitted into the prompt in this order so the sentence always reads in the same shape.
emission_order_note: The identity block (everything before medium) is emitted first, then the style core, then the medium core, then lighting, composition and the quality tail. Lighting words inside the style core are stripped automatically, so a style's default lighting never fights the medium you chose.

slots.question_en: What exactly is this character? One noun phrase, species- and object-specific.
slots.question_zh: 这个角色到底是什么？一句话名词短语，越具体越好。
examples: a small round tortoise with moss on its shell
a 1950s-style diner coffee mug with a chipped rim
a cloud made of condensation vapour
an origami paper crane
a desk lamp
slots.lock_rule: Never change this across shots. If the generator drifts, restate this phrase verbatim at the START of the prompt, before any style words.

slots.question_en: What job does this character do on camera?
slots.question_zh: 这个角色在频道里负责什么？
slots.lock_rule: Drives pose and framing. Keep it constant so the character's function reads consistently.

slots.question_en: The single feature that must be recognisable at thumbnail size. Exactly one.
slots.question_zh: 缩略图尺寸下也能认出的那一个特征，只写一个。
examples: one oversized round yellow rain boot
a single antenna with a red bead on the tip
a third eye on the forehead
a scarf that never stops trailing
slots.lock_rule: The most important lock. Repeat this exact phrase in EVERY prompt, every shot, every expression. This is the identifier.

examples: two-head-tall chibi proportions with mitten hands
1:3.5 proportions with an upright bipedal stance
1:7 realistic adult human proportions
blocky 1:3 proportions with cubic limbs
slots.lock_rule: Generators default to 1:7 human proportions. If you want chibi you must state the ratio numerically.

slots.question_en: Describe the outline in one short phrase, as a single dark shape.
slots.question_zh: 用一个短语描述纯黑剪影的轮廓。
examples: a round triangle silhouette
a tall thin hourglass silhouette
a wide low mushroom silhouette
slots.lock_rule: Test the silhouette alone (solid black fill) before generating the full character. If the silhouette is not distinctive, redesign.

slots.question_en: 2-5 named colours with roles. More than 5 kills recognition.
slots.question_zh: 2到5个具名颜色并标注作用，超过5个会失去辨识度。
examples: primary teal, secondary cream, accent coral, deep charcoal outline
primary mustard yellow, accent rust orange, one deep teal secondary, charcoal outline
primary off-white, accent single red, warm grey secondary
slots.lock_rule: Always name an outline colour. A named outline colour is the single most effective consistency lock across renders.

slots.question_en: What is the character physically made of?
slots.question_zh: 角色在物理上由什么构成？
examples: matte painted plastic with a slightly rough surface
wool felt with visible individual fibres
glossy injection-moulded vinyl with a parting seam
slots.lock_rule: One primary material plus one secondary material only. More reads as visual noise.

examples: a simple cream turtleneck
a red headband and one oversized jacket
no clothing, a natural body
slots.lock_rule: Keep the outfit identical across shots even when the pose changes. Wardrobe drift is the most common character-inconsistency failure.

slots.question_en: The single dominant emotion. One word plus a mouth description.
slots.question_zh: 单一主导情绪，一个情绪词加嘴部描述。
examples: confident half-smile with one eyebrow raised
wide open-mouthed delight
flat unimpressed stare with a straight-line mouth
slots.lock_rule: The shape of the mouth does more work than the eyes. Describe mouth shape explicitly.

slots.question_en: What is the body doing, and where in frame?
slots.question_zh: 身体在做什么，在画面哪个位置？
examples: standing front-facing in a centred full-body shot
three-quarter turn with one hand on the hip
leaning forward in a medium close-up, looking straight at the viewer
slots.lock_rule: For identity shots, always use a neutral front-facing pose. Reserve dramatic poses for later, once the identity is locked.

examples: a plain soft pastel gradient background
on a wooden desk in a warm study
in a sparse white studio with a subtle contact shadow
slots.lock_rule: For identity and turnaround shots use a plain or minimally-specified background so the character reads. Save the world for scene shots.

slots.question_en: One small repeatable graphic device that ties the character to a brand.
slots.question_zh: 一个可重复出现的小图形记号，用来把角色和品牌绑在一起。
examples: a small three-dot mark on the shoulder
a stitched X on the left ear
a single diagonal stripe on the chest
slots.lock_rule: Add this to every prompt once it exists. It is the cheapest extra identity lock you can keep.

slots.question_zh: 使用 media.json 里的哪种画面媒介？
slots.note: Orthogonal to the style. Choose one style from styles.json and one medium from media.json.
slots.lock_rule: Never change medium mid-series. Mixing media across shots destroys perceived continuity more than any other change.

slots.question_en: One light setup, named by direction and hardness.
slots.question_zh: 一组布光，写清方向与软硬。
examples: soft large-area key from upper front with a gentle rim light
single hard key from upper left with graphic shadow shapes
warm backlight exploiting translucency
slots.lock_rule: Hold lighting constant across an identity series, then vary it deliberately for scene beats.

slots.question_en: Framing, shot size and aspect ratio.
slots.note: Aspect ratio strings are platform-agnostic; see deliverables.json for the full list.
slots.lock_rule: Pick the ratio before writing the prompt. Never change ratio mid-series without regenerating all frames.

slots.question_zh: 渲染质量与细节密度收尾词。
slots.note: Optional per-platform override; default is platform-agnostic and works in most engines.
slots.lock_rule: Keep the same tail everywhere so detail density matches frame to frame.

proportion_presets.en: one head tall, a single mass with no distinct limbs
proportion_presets.zh: 一头身，整体无明显四肢

proportion_presets.en: one and a half head tall proportions with tiny stub limbs

proportion_presets.use: maximum cuteness, sticker and reaction use
